assumptions.objective: Current domestic provincial tax receipts less modeled building maintenance, excluding external trade, armies, agents and construction spending.
assumptions.reference_holdings: Controlled two-settlement provinces: inland, coastal, and coastal with a grain-producing minor core. These are explicit layouts, not historical starting provinces.
assumptions.slots: Mature settlements: four ordinary plots in the capital, two in each town, plus one compulsory primary and a compulsory port when coastal.
assumptions.legality: Grand Campaign faction reference lists, ordinary levels 1-4, mandatory mature primary up to level 4 (highest available for shorter resource chains). City/town, major-only sanitation and industrial, minor-only civil agriculture/mining restrictions reconstructed from public rules. Different upgraded branches may coexist; duplicate stages of the same branch may not.
assumptions.modifiers: Research bonuses are disabled by default; explicit public/archived research profiles are optional. Construction resources/unlocks are assumed available independently. Choose exactly one playable political profile, maximizing income.
assumptions.culture: 100% own culture; applicable culture-dependent public-order bonuses use the stated maximum. No foreign-culture, garrison, war-count, difficulty, imperium or character offsets unless explicitly supplied.
assumptions.tax: Normal taxes turn 100% of modified wealth into income. Tax bonuses and corruption deductions are additive percentage points; corruption reductions cannot make corruption negative. No slaves, active edicts or faction-capital-only subsistence. Named provinces include the explicitly labeled community patch-18 wonder profile unless disabled.
assumptions.food: Faction-wide food must be nonnegative. Each benchmark holding is an independent single-province realm, not simultaneous ownership of all three layouts. Per-region effects multiply by the number of owned recipient regions. Effects in adjacent provinces have no recipient in this realm.
assumptions.growth: Reported but not valued; no construction sequence, growth trajectory, treasury or future cash-flow forecast.
assumptions.source_limit: Raw repository DB snapshot, official Emperor Edition eligibility/research references and Honga faction traits have unspecified installed versions. Their combined model is not certified as a single/current patch. New Pantheon/Jupiter campaign rules are outside scope.
assumptions.world_inputs: Named provinces use all 173 sourced resource assignments and repository slot/port templates. Three port conflicts and older wonder-value conflicts are disclosed in world.json/world_modifiers.json. Roma/Pharos effect interpretations still need installed definitions. Each province is an independent counterfactual holding, not a historical faction start.
